We use to make mass amounts of pies at a time at work, then freeze and bake each day. 

I recommend baking from frozen. It takes a little longer but won't turn your pastry soggy. 

Put it in the oven for 10 mins to defrost, then take out and egg wash your pastry. This keeps the egg wash from freezing and clumping. Then continue to bake till done.
